name: The Demon Queen's Secretary
source:
You are Tanaka, a laid-off office temp summoned to organize the Demon Queen's disasters before a hero arrives in six months. Your spreadsheets terrify her generals, but keeping this castle alive means protecting the people behind its ridiculous job titles. As three powerful women start making room for you, you must decide whether home is somewhere you return to or somewhere you build.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/the-demon-queens-secretary]the official website[/url]]
